template_meta.name: Flat_Banner_Stat_Card_Hand_Hero
template_meta.description: A flat colour banner across the top holds a bold pun headline, a rounded stat card (no outline) stacks 4 punchy numeric benefit callouts on the left with one key stat highlighted in an accent colour, and a photorealistic hand holds the true-to-scale hero product on the right against a soft glowing gradient background. A brand logo is composited into the bottom-right corner as a post-processing step (not part of the generative prompt) to guarantee pixel-exact placement.

post_processing.logo_overlay: After generation, composite {user_inputs.logo_image} into the bottom-right corner via direct image overlay (e.g. ffmpeg 'overlay' filter) rather than describing it in the generative prompt — keeps every other pixel of the approved render untouched. Scale logo to roughly 20-23% of canvas width, ~28px padding from the right and bottom edges.

user_inputs.headline_text: [INSERT PUNCHY HEADLINE — 3-4 words, plays on 'X with benefits']
user_inputs.headline_font_family: [INSERT BRAND HEADING FONT — e.g. 'Metric Bold, geometric sans-serif' or 'Fraunces Black, heavy serif']
user_inputs.product_image: [UPLOAD PRODUCT IMAGE — clean background or transparent PNG preferred]
user_inputs.logo_image: [UPLOAD BRAND LOGO — transparent PNG preferred, composited bottom-right after generation]
user_inputs.hand_skin_tone: [INSERT SKIN TONE DESCRIPTION, e.g. 'light-medium, neutral undertone']
user_inputs.key_stat_badge_hex: [INSERT KEY/HEADLINE STAT BADGE FILL HEX, e.g. brand accent colour]
user_inputs.product_real_world_height_cm: [INSERT PRODUCT'S ACTUAL HEIGHT IN CM, e.g. '30' for a 2L bottle — used to keep scale true to life against the hand]

sections.bottom_edge: flat, straight horizontal edge — no drip, wave, or texture

elements.overflow_direction: upward — top of product may nudge into the banner's underside

rendering.style: photorealistic, close-up hand holding the product at a natural angle, product label facing camera; product scaled true-to-life against the hand using {user_inputs.product_real_world_height_cm}cm as the real-world reference height
rendering.hand: realistic human hand and forearm, skin tone: {user_inputs.hand_skin_tone}, natural nails, relaxed grip
rendering.lighting: soft diffused studio light, gentle highlight top-right
rendering.shadow: soft contact shadow beneath product, colour-matched to background

generative_image_prompt: A 2000x2000px square ad for {user_inputs.brand_name}. TOP BANNER (top 21% of canvas): a horizontal band filled with a smooth vertical gradient from {user_inputs.banner_gradient_top_hex} at the very top to {user_inputs.banner_gradient_bottom_hex} at its base, with a flat, straight bottom edge — no drip, wave, or texture of any kind. Centered in this banner, bold white text set in {user_inputs.headline_font_family} reads '{user_inputs.headline_text}' — large, confident, single or double line. MAIN BODY (remaining 79% below): background is a soft gradient from {user_inputs.bg_gradient_top_hex} to {user_inputs.bg_gradient_bottom_hex} with a gentle radial glow centred behind the product, evoking a clean, airy studio backdrop. On the LEFT (starting ~8% from left edge, ~12% down from the body top, spanning ~26% of canvas width and ~76% of body height): a tall rounded-rectangle card (60px corner radius) filled solid {user_inputs.stat_card_hex} with NO border, outline, or stroke of any kind around the card or around the circular badge inside it — edges are a clean flat colour fill only. Near the top of the card sits a circular badge filled solid {user_inputs.key_stat_badge_hex} containing bold white text '{user_inputs.stat_1_value}' with a smaller bold white label '{user_inputs.stat_1_label}' beneath it, centred. Below the badge, three more stacked rows of centred white bold text, each pairing a large stat value with a smaller label beneath: '{user_inputs.stat_2_value}' / '{user_inputs.stat_2_label}', then '{user_inputs.stat_3_value}' / '{user_inputs.stat_3_label}', then '{user_inputs.stat_4_value}' / '{user_inputs.stat_4_label}', evenly spaced down the card. On the RIGHT side of the main body (starting around 68% across, top edge tucked just under the banner): a photorealistic close-up of a human hand and forearm (skin tone: {user_inputs.hand_skin_tone}) naturally holding {user_inputs.product_name}, label facing the camera, softly lit with a diffused studio light and a subtle highlight from the top right, with a soft contact shadow beneath the product blending into the background gradient. CRITICAL SCALE: the product is {user_inputs.product_real_world_height_cm}cm tall in real life — render it true-to-life relative to the hand and forearm holding it, so the product's actual proportions (visibly taller than the hand is wide, extending well past the palm) are respected rather than shrunk to fit the composition. Overall mood: clean, confident, benefit-led product ad with a bold flat-colour graphic style. Output: 2000x2000px, 1:1 aspect ratio, RGB, photorealistic product and hand rendering with clean flat-illustration text overlays.
